༄༅/ /maṇḍal 'bul ba'i cho ga gling bzhi'i rgyan gyur bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: rgyan gyur bzhugs so/ / dpal ldan tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i lha/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho la btud de/ /maṇḍal 'bul ba'i cho ga ni/ /gling bzhi'i rgyan gyur brjod par bya/ / maṇḍal lan gsum phyis te/ tshom bu bco lnga bkod la/ zhing khams phun sum tshogs pa 'dod dgu'i 'byor bar dmigs te/ bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dkon mchog gsum mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar bsams la/ dbyangs snyan pos mgrin gcig tu 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sna tshogs khams can sems can dbyings mtha' ji srid bar/ /ma lus kun khyab gzugs dang bkod pa dpag yas rgya mtsho'i snying po can/ /gang chen mtshos brgyan lha mi'i mchod sprin nam mkha'i dbyings kun ji tsam pa/ /de snyed rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas mchod 'os rnams la gus pas 'bul/ /gser gyi sa gzhi ri rab lhun pos brgyan/ /gling bzhi gling phran nyi zla gza' skar bkram/ /lha mi 'dod yon phun tshogs dang ldan pa/ /gling bzhi 'jig rten rgyan gyur rnams kyis mchod/ /rin chen chu mtsho me tog gis bkram rnam dag padmo'i gzhal yas khang*/ /chu dang yid bzhin dbang pos nyer brten sa 'og sa steng sa bla dang*/ / bar snang la gnas khang brtsegs yid 'ong rnam mang 'dod lha'i skyed mo'i tshal/ /'od dang gzi brjid dpal du 'bar bas 'gro ba'i bla ma sras bcas mchod/ /gser dang dngul dang shel dang ind+ra nīl/ /mar gad mu sa gar ba baiḍūrya/ /yid bzhin nor bu sna tshogs mdzes 'bar ba/ /bum bzang dpag bsam shing chen rnams kyis mchod/ /ku mud ta dang ud pal me tog dri ldan pa/ /mdangs bkra yid 'ong kha bye lhag ger gsal gyur cing*/ /nor bu'i rkang gdub yid 'ong 'khrol bas mdzes byas pa/ /lha mi'i bu mo bstod dbyangs sgrogs ldan rnams kyis mchod/ /rin chen bdun dang bkra shis rnam pa brgyad/

/gzhal yas khang mdzes yul 'khor nyams dga' ba/ /mi dbang dpal te phun tshogs 'di phul bas/ /rgyal ba'i 'byor tshogs lhun gyis grub par shog /bsam gtan lha gnas shin tu nyams dga' dang pa'i 'od kyi gzhal yas khang*/ rnam bkra gzugs bzang lha mang gis mdzes ting 'dzin zhi ba'i skyed mos tshal/ /rtse gcig mi g.yo gzugs med rab zhi bsod nams sprin gtsang snying po can/ /srid gsum snod bcud dngos dang dngos med bde dga'i rgya mtsho rnams kyis mchod/ /nyan thos rang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems/ /rgyal ba'i gzugs sprin snying po las thon pa/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho yis/ /bla ma yid dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod/ /dag pa'i zhing khams rgyas sras 'byor pas yongs gang lha mi'i bde 'byung gnas/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sprin phung dang bcas ye shes las grub gzhal yas khang*/ /nam mkha'i dbyings khyab longs sku'i dpal 'byor chos sku'i zhing gi snying po can/ /ma lus yongs bkod bde chen rgya mtshor 'gro kun phyam cig bgrod par shog /rin chen maṇḍal kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin/ / srid zhi'i 'byor tshogs dpag med dang ldan pa/ /phun tshogs bsod nams zhing la phul ba yis/ /'gro kun thar pa'i grong du phyin par shog /ces pa'am/ yang na de nyid rgyun chags dang tshigs bcad spel mas dbul ba ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sna tshogs khams can sems can dbyings mtha' ji srid ma lus kun khyab gzugs dang bkod pa dpag yas rgya mtsho'i snying po gang chen mtshos brgyan lha mi'i mchod sprin nam mkha'i dbyings kun ji tsam de snyed rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas mchod 'os rnams la gus par 'bul/ gser gyi sa gzhi ri dbang lhun pos brgyan/ /gling bzhi gling phran nyi zla gza' skar bkram/ /lha mi'i 'dod yon phun tshogs dang ldan pa/ /gling bzhi 'jig rten rgyan gyur rnams kyis mchod/

/rin chen chu mtsho me tog gis bkram rnam dag padmo'i gzhal yas chu dang yid bzhin dbang pos nyer brten sa 'og sa steng sa bla bar snang la gnas khang brtsegs yid 'ong rnam mang 'dod lha'i skyed tshal 'od dang gzi brjid dpal du 'bar bas 'gro ba'i bla ma sras bcas mchod/ gser dang shel dang dngul dang ind+ra nīl/ /mar gad mu sa gar ba bai ḍūrya/ /yid bzhin nor bu sna tshogs mdzes 'bar la/ /bum bzang dpag bsam shing chen rnams kyis mchod/ /ku mu ta dang utpal me tog dri ldan mdangs bkra yid 'ong kha bye lhag ger gsal gyur nor bu'i rkang gdub yid 'ong 'khrol bas mdzes byas lha mi'i bu mo bstod dbyangs sgrogs ldan rnams kyis mchod/ /rin chen bdun dang bkra shis rnam pa brgyad/ gzhal yas khang mdzes yul 'khor nyams dga' ba/ mi dbang dpal te phun tshogs 'ad ི phu la bas/ /rgyal ba'i 'byor tshogs lhun gyis grub par shog /bsam gtan lha gnas shin tu nyams dga' dngas ba'i 'od kyi gzhal yas rnam bkra gzugs bzang lha mang gis mdzes ting 'dzin zhi ba'i skyed mos rtse gcig mi g.yo gzugs med rab zhi bsod nams sprin gtsang snying po srid gsum snod bcud dngos dang dngos med bde dga'i rgya mtsho rnams kyis mchod/ /nyan thos rang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems/ /rgyal ba'i gzugs sprin snying po las 'thon pa/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho yis/ /bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod/ /dag pa'i zhingakhams rgyal sras 'byor pas yongs gang lha mi'i bde 'byung rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sprin phung dang bcas ye shes las grub gzhal yas nam mkha'i dbyings khyab longs sku'i dpal 'byor chos sku'i zhing gi snying po ma lus yongs bkod bde chen rgya mtshor 'gro kun phyam gcig bgrod par shog /rin chen maṇḍal kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin/ /srid zhi'i 'byor tshogs dpag med dang ldan pa/

/phun tshogs bsod nams zhing la phul ba yis/ /'gro kun thar pa'i grong du phyin par shog /ces 'bul lo/ /dad ldan rnams kyis nyin dang mtshan/ /thun bzhir tshogs chen rdzogs bya'i phyir/ /ting 'dzin dbyangs snyan me tog bcas/ /rab dngas yid kyis dbul bar bya/ /dge bas bdag dang 'gro ba kun/ /byang chub rgya mtsho mtha' yas shog /maṇḍal 'bul ba'i cho ga gling bzhi'i rgyan gyur zhes bya ba/ theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa/ sna tshogs rang grol gyis rang byung padma'i gnas su sbyar ba rdzogs so/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ / dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (11)maṇḍal 'bul ba'i cho ga gling bzhi'i rgyan gyur/ - PAGE 32 - - PAGE 33 -- PAGE 29 -
